Data-model analysis · quality review

Power BI Model Audit

A source-to-report technical audit of a Power BI model, with attention to transformation logic, relationships, measures, and filter behavior.

  • RoleModel audit & calculation testing
  • TechnologyPower BI · DAX · data modeling
  • ContextProject-controls analysis

The problem

Before a large financial and project-controls report can be relied on, the team needs to understand its source connections, transformation logic, relationships, calculations, and the places where labels or filters can alter interpretation.

Approach

I performed a read-only technical audit. I traced Power Query, relationships, calculated tables, DAX measures, and report bindings, then used targeted tests to compare calculation behavior under different scopes and filters.

Key decisions

  • Separate confirmed implementation behavior from business assumptions that require stakeholder validation.
  • Trace the route from source data to report output before evaluating a measure in isolation.
  • Use reproducible filter and calculation tests rather than visual impressions alone.
  • Communicate model limits clearly without exposing private financial sensitivities.

What it demonstrates

Careful model review, reproducible calculation testing, and clear communication about what a reporting system can and cannot establish.

Contribution boundary

This is an audit case study. It does not claim authorship of the report or its dashboards.
